packageRules.description: The shared reusable workflows are consumed from @main on purpose: that is how a wordpress-plugin-workflows change reaches every plugin at once. A digest pin turns each of those changes into a per-repo PR.

instantiator 2.x declares php ^8.4 and uses typed class constants. The canary installs the dev tree on the host at 8.4 but runs PHPUnit in-container down to 8.2, where it fatals on the first createMock(). See 5e5c0ff.
yoast/phpunit-polyfills 4.0 constrains PHPUnit to ^12 and below. Lift this once it supports 13.
